title: POC workshop roadmap & task runbook - Acme Retail pilot
content:
Purpose / brief

This doc is the working runbook for the Acme Retail POC: a 6‑week engagement to validate Redwood inference for product recommendation reranking and a chat assistant (catalog search + buyer guidance). Goals: prove latency & cost targets on both Redwood Dedicated (customer-reserved pool) and a Private VPC deployment, validate model fallback policies, and deliver a deployment playbook the customer can use after the POC.

High-level success criteria (stakeholder-aligned)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 150ms for 512-token horizon on dedicated pool under 100 RPS traffic profile.
- Cost: token cost reduction target relative to baseline model-serving approach >= 30% via batching + caching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
- Quality: recommendation rerank top-1 accuracy within 5% of baseline (measured against Acme dev set).
- Operability: SRE checklist completed, rollout playbook reviewed, and 2 knowledge-transfer sessions delivered.

Schedule summary (6 weeks)
- Week 0: Pre-kickoff (account setup, access, dataset handoff) — 3 working days
- Week 1: Kickoff workshop + initial infra spin-up (Dedicated staging pool & Private VPC test)
- Week 2: Baseline integration + inferencing pipeline validation (metrics + logs)
- Week 3: Optimize phase (batching, KV caching, quantization test) + mid-POC demo
- Week 4: Load testing and SLA verification; fallback path testing
- Week 5: Runbook finalization, handover, and executive demo

POC workshop agenda (kickoff meeting)
- 0:00–0:10 Introductions and objectives (SE + Acme product & infra owners)
- 0:10–0:25 POC success criteria and acceptance gating (review list above)
- 0:25–0:45 Architecture review: Redwood modes (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) and what we'll deploy
- 0:45–1:00 Initial timeline + immediate dependencies (keys, VPC peering, dataset, traffic profile)
- Action items captured live in JIRA:SE-2345.

Immediate pre-work (before week 1 kickoff)
- Acme: share sample prod-like dataset (>= 50k sessions) and traffic profile CSV — owner: Acme infra (due: 2024-09-22)
- SE: provision staging Dedicated pool + generate temp API keys for integration — owner: Diego Ramos (due: 2024-09-24)
- Infra: VPC peering request ticket raised (INFRA-678) and RBAC review scheduled — owner: Jordan Lee (due: 2024-09-25)

Environment topology (what we will deploy)
- Dedicated staging: 4x A100-equivalent GPUs, autoscaler disabled for deterministic latencies, pinned model artifact v1.2.
- Private test: small VPC deploy (customer-controlled), KMS test key, audit logging enabled, NAT egress for model downloads.
- Observability: Redwood Console per-route dashboards + token-level traces enabled, export to Acme Datadog namespace.

Risk register (high level)
- Risk: Dataset contains PII and cannot leave Acme network. Mitigation: run model inference inside Private deployment only; ensure logs scrubbing. Owner: Elena.
- Risk: Dedicated pool capacity delayed. Mitigation: fall back to Hosted API for early validation; run latency extrapolation tests. Owner: Diego.
- Risk: Metric mismatch (Acme baseline uses different tokenization). Mitigation: align on tokenizer and evaluation script in week 1. Owner: Samir.

Task tracker (working list — use this to populate JIRA)
- SE-2346: Create integration test harness (pytest + smoke) for reranking endpoint — owner: Samir Gupta — status: in_progress — est: 3 days
- SE-2347: Configure Dedicated staging pool and pin model v1.2 — owner: Diego Ramos — status: done — est: 1 day
- SE-2348: Private VPC deploy script and KMS integration (terraform module) — owner: Jordan Lee — status: in_review — est: 4 days 
- SE-2349: Observability wiring (Datadog export, per-route dashboards) — owner: Elena Karpova — status: todo — est: 2 days
- SE-2350: Load test plan + k6 scripts for 100 RPS profile — owner: Maya Chen — status: todo — est: 3 days

Notes on measurement and tooling
- Use Redwood Console traces + per-token cost breakdown to attribute cost savings from batching and caching. Export CSV daily to confluence page.
- Evaluation: run reranking evals against the provided Acme dev set; use seed and deterministic sampling (scripts in GITHUB PR). Reference: GITHUB:https://github.com/redwood-inference/poc-acme-retail

Operational runbook (checklist for cutover)
- Pre-cutover checklist
  - Confirm Dedicated staging pool health (GPU temps, utilization, kernel versions) — SRE owner: Jordan
  - Validate KV cache priming for most common prefixes (script: tools/prime_cache.sh) — SE owner: Samir
  - Confirm rollout policy for canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback to Hosted API on error rate > 1%
  - Ensure alerting thresholds set: p95 latency, error rate, token spend rate (Datadog dashboards)

- Cutover steps
  1. Switch 5% traffic to Dedicated endpoint (canary) and monitor for 15m.
  2. If p95 latency < target and error rate < 0.5%, increase to 25%.
  3. If anomaly detected, rollback to Hosted API and open SE incident (JIRA:SE-INC-1).

Quality experiments to run during week 3
- Quantization sweep (int8 vs int4) for rerank model to measure quality delta vs latency improvement. Track with Redwood Optimize suggestions and register results in confluence.
- Batching test matrix: batch sizes [1,4,8,16], request aggregation latency budgets [5ms, 10ms]. Measure p95/p99 and throughput.

Deliverables by end of POC
- POC report: latency, cost, quality results and recommended production configuration (doc + slides).
- Deployment playbook: terraform modules, runbook, and rollback steps.
- Knowledge transfer: 2x 60-min sessions (operators + eng) + recording saved to confluence.

Open questions for Acme (to resolve in kickoff)
- Which datasets are allowed to leave VPC (if any)?
- Who will operate the Dedicated capacity contract after POC (Acme infra or Redwood-managed)?
- What are the exact SLOs they care about beyond p95 latency (e.g., p99, tail percentiles)?

Decisions made so far (notes)
- Decided to pin model artifact rather than live-pulling during tests to reduce variance. (Diego, 2024-09-20)
- Canary rollout policy agreed: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (Elena, 2024-09-21)

Next immediate steps (this week)
- Finish integration harness (SE-2346) and post results to PR. Owner: Samir. Due: 2024-09-26.
- Confirm VPC peering and KMS access for Private test. Owner: Jordan. Due: 2024-09-25.
- Send kickoff invite and pre-read to Acme stakeholders with agenda and success criteria. Owner: Maya. Due: 2024-09-20.

Appendix: useful links + snippets
- Quick debug commands:
  - tail logs: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/logs?route=acme-rerank
  - prime cache: python tools/prime_cache.py --file sample_prefixes.csv

- Reference confluence pages and templates: POC report template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/POC+Report+Template

Local draft notes (scratchpad)
- 2024-09-19: customer prefers Private deployment for compliance — need to ensure no model weights leave their subnet. Confirm with legal.
- 2024-09-20: observed baseline model uses sentencepiece tokenization; coordinate with Samir to re-tokenize dev set.

If anything here is unclear or you want this broken into a timeline GANTT or a spreadsheet, say so and I'll export a sheet and seed the JIRA tasks.
